title: Bin Meter
shortDescription: Recycle Bin manager for Command Palette.
description:
A Recycle Bin manager for Command Palette.

Features:
- View files in the Recycle Bin.
- Restore or permanently delete files from the list.
- Sort files by date or size.
- Open or empty the Recycle Bin with quick actions.
- Add dock bands that show the current Recycle Bin size, file count, or percentage full.
- Customize what size is considered full in the settings.
